content: .{@-अमरा@} The five plants {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>भांग, दूर्वा, बेल, निर्गुडी</ns> and तुळस. .{@-अमृत@}) {%a.%} consisting of 5 ingredients. . ({@-तम्@}) .²1 the aggregate of five drugs: dry ginger, a species of Moon-seed (Cocculus cordifolius, <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>गुळवेल</ns>), Asparagus racemosus (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>शतावरी</ns>), Hypoxis brevifolia (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>मुसळी</ns>), गोक्षुरक (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>गोखरूं</ns>). .²2 the collection of five sweet things used in worshipping deities; (दुग्धं च शर्करा चैव घृतं दधि तथा मधु). .²3 the five elements; <ls>Māl. 5. 2</ls>.
